surukle_ipucu: Click a Target block, then a Command block, to build a new step (no dragging needed) — or type directly into the fields.
blok_tikla_ipucu: Click to add to the last step
bos_adim_placeholder: // No steps yet — click "Add Step" to begin
adreslenemeyen_not: This module's axes can't be targeted separately — module-level only
ice_aktarilmadi_placeholder: Import a project XML first to see blocks
standart_tablolar_ipucu: 8 standard tables (Prepare/Auto/Manual/Stop/Start/Abort/Hold/BrakeRelease) are created automatically — just fill in the steps.
output_placeholder: // drag a block in and fill the condition
decl_placeholder: // VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT/VAR declarations will appear here as you use blocks — edit freely, add STRUCT definitions
decl_new_var_tpl: ⚠ {count} new/unknown-type variable(s) found (marked "// NEW" below) — check their types before adding them to your real program!
mode_usage: from usage (no declarations found, prefix + read/write heuristic)
vars_found_tpl: {count} variables found ({mode}) — {input} inputs, {output} outputs, {local} local/other. Shown on the left as "name : type;" — edit freely.
parse_code_empty: Code is empty or no statements were found.
parse_code_partial_tpl: {count} block(s) created, then parsing stopped: {error} — context: {context}
tooltip_if: IF/THEN/ELSIF/ELSE conditional branch. Right-click: add/remove ELSIF/ELSE
tooltip_case: CASE...OF multi-way branch (state machine). Right-click: add/remove arm
tooltip_call: Function/procedure call as a statement (returns no value). Right-click: add/remove parameter
tooltip_exprcall: Value-returning function call — plugs into a value socket. Right-click: add/remove parameter
tooltip_timer: Calls a function block instance such as TON/TOF/R_TRIG/F_TRIG. To read outputs (.Q / .ET) write instance.Q into a "Variable" block
tooltip_logic: AND / OR / XOR — combines two Boolean values
tooltip_math: Arithmetic operation (+, -, *, /, MOD) — produces a numeric value
orphan_value_block_tpl: not connected (drag it onto the right side of an assignment or a parameter): {code}
tooltip_var: A variable name, constant, or free-text expression
tooltip_comment: Comment line — starts with // in the generated code, has no effect
tooltip_assign: Assignment — writes the right-hand value into the left-hand variable (:=)
tooltip_for: FOR loop — repeats the steps inside while stepping the variable from start to end
tooltip_continue: CONTINUE — skips to the next loop iteration, only meaningful inside FOR/WHILE
tooltip_time_lit: A time constant, e.g. T#2S, T#500MS
